caption:
🧠 DID YOU KNOW? 🤯

Why You Should Stop Charging Your Phone to 100% 🔋

💡 Holding a phone battery at 100% under high voltage and heat causes micro-cracks in lithium electrodes. Keeping charge between 20% and 80% doubles total battery lifespan.
